_about: Curated register of coming regulatory changes that no template specification describes (proposals, application-date milestones). Customer-framed. 'date' is the exact date from the cited Official-Journal text where one is fixed, null where the regulator has not set one — never invented. Changes that a draft specification captures (data/reference/regspec) are generated from it and its machine diff, not listed here.

changes.title: EUDR obligations take effect
changes.whats_changing: Due-diligence and Due-Diligence-Statement submission become mandatory for in-scope commodities placed on the EU market.
changes.prepare: Geolocation polygons for every covered plot, plus legality evidence.

data_fields.field: Plot geolocation — polygon vertices (lat/long), or a point for plots ≤ 4 ha
Commodity + HS code, and production quantity

data_fields.note: land-use rights, EUDR Annex-II legality documents

changes.title: EU Taxonomy — environmental objectives
changes.whats_changing: Taxonomy alignment extends beyond climate mitigation & adaptation to water, circular economy, pollution prevention and biodiversity.
changes.prepare: Activity-level data against the four additional environmental objectives.

data_fields.note: map each activity to a Taxonomy activity

data_fields.field: Turnover / CapEx / OpEx attributable to each activity

changes.title: ESRS digital tagging (XBRL)
changes.when: no fixed date · phased with ESAP go-live (from 2027)
changes.whats_changing: Sustainability statements must be tagged in the EFRAG ESRS XBRL taxonomy for machine-readable filing to the European Single Access Point.
changes.citation: EFRAG ESRS XBRL taxonomy · ESAP Regulation (EU) 2023/2859

changes.title: CSRD / ESRS — Omnibus (‘stop-the-clock’)
changes.when: Dir. (EU) 2025/794 (Apr 2025) — next waves delayed to FY2027 / FY2028; scope still in negotiation
changes.whats_changing: The ‘stop-the-clock’ Directive postpones the next CSRD reporting waves by two years; the substantive scope changes (Omnibus) are still under EU negotiation.
changes.prepare: No action yet — you'll be told if your own obligations change.

changes.title: SFDR 2.0 — Commission proposal
changes.when: Commission proposal COM(2025) 841 (20 Nov 2025) · in negotiation · would apply 18 months after entry into force
changes.whats_changing: The proposal deletes the entity-level principal adverse impacts statement (SFDR Articles 4 and 5) and repeals Delegated Regulation (EU) 2022/1288. Until it is adopted and applies, the statement stays mandatory.

changes.title: IFRS S2 / ISSB adoption
changes.when: date set per jurisdiction on ISSB adoption
changes.whats_changing: IFRS S2 climate-related disclosures become required where a jurisdiction adopts the ISSB standards.
